title: At the Uttermost Parts of the Sea

keywords: at the uttermost parts of the sea
full_text:
Trapped in the colossal pack-ice of the Arctic ocean, a Danish exploration ship lay frozen, battered by pitch-black polar storms. The crew shivered around a single smoking lamp, their provisions running low and death staring them in the face.

The captain opened the old family Bible and began singing a simple evening hymn: "Though I fly to the uttermost parts of the sea, Thy hand shall lead me."

The sailors joined in chorus. Across thousands of miles of frozen waste, the melody reached the hearts of their loved ones praying by warm hearths at home. Peace filled the frozen cabin, and when the ice split in the spring thaw, the vessel sailed into open waters, guided by the everlasting hand.
moral: Even in the desolate ice of the polar sea, the hymn of faith unites human hearts with home and heaven.
